title: MODERATION-001 Trusted Reviewer Admission Input Contract
purpose: Define the minimum trusted server-side reviewer context required before W06 moderation Queue/Case/Decision runtime may execute. This contract does not create a new transport or authority.

authenticatedPrincipal.source: W01 authenticated server principal established through existing W01→W02 session-authority path

reviewerIdentity.source: server-derived principal identity bound to the current authenticated administrative session

reviewerLayer.source: canonical authorization layer/role authority; minimum L6 for moderation permissions

permissionContext.source: canonical authz permissions + server-derived reviewer scope

caseId.source: canonical route/path parameter for case-scoped operations

expectedVersion.source: client DTO value checked against authoritative W06 case version

conditionalRequest.source: canonical conditional-request contract; representation must match current case version/ETag

admissionDecision.rule: W06 MUST fail closed unless authenticated principal, reviewer layer, permission scope, and required concurrency/provenance inputs are present and bound to admitted authorities.

rules: No end-user bearer token is forwarded to W06 as an authority credential.
Reviewer identity and layer MUST be server-derived; client fields with those meanings are rejected or ignored.
Internal origin alone MUST NOT establish moderation authority.
The transport MUST preserve actor, subject/case scope and correlation context.
Reviewer scope MUST be checked for every queue/case/decision operation.
Missing reviewer authority input MUST fail closed.
Decision writes MUST require Idempotency-Key and If-Match/expectedVersion consistency.
Raw evidence and internal risk thresholds MUST NOT cross the reviewer DTO boundary unless separately contracted.

evidenceRequiredBeforeImplementationAdmi: verified W01 authenticated principal propagation to the moderation boundary
trusted internal transport binding to W06
implementationRule: This contract does not authorize W06 runtime implementation. Runtime remains blocked until each MISSING_AUTHORITY_BINDING is reconciled to an existing authoritative source and admitted evidence is produced.
nonGoals: No new Service Binding is created by this contract.
No direct W02→W06 business Service Binding is inferred.
